_doc: One entry per run family shown on the hub page (scripts/build_research_page.py). Add a new iteration as a NEW entry with its own arch/<id>.md snapshot; never edit a finished iteration's runs or arch file unless explicitly replacing it. `slot` pins the family's chart colour (1-8); give a new family the next unused slot so existing lines keep their colour.

baselines.label: GoWU Phase I (ours)
baselines.about: Our GoWU reproduction, paper v4 defaults, restores emulator states. Best trajectory found so far (not a deployable policy). Seeds 8/9 were stopped at 100M by the campaign's early-stop rule.

baselines.label: GoWU Phase I + trap fix
baselines.change: Not in the paper: a winner confined to one room at the same R for 200 iterations marks those cells as dead states (room-8 rope-post trap).
baselines.verdict: Fix fired once per seed in level-2 room 8 and both seeds escaped: level 3 reached at 213M / 134M (baseline: stuck at 34,200 / 39,200). ~71-72k when they first reached level 3's treasure room (302M / 252M); after that a treasure-room jewel loop (+1000 repeated, score wraps at 1,000,000) runs best R to the 999,100 cap. Everything above ~72k is the loop, not progress.

baselines.label: GWRW (route walker, fresh start)
baselines.about: montezuma_gwrw package (gwrw_cd_v1 code, unchanged), fresh start without its CKPT14 / pool seed, shipped live json, 96 games per run, two replicates to 400M frames. Pixels + reward only, no restores, sticky actions.
baselines.verdict: Same plateau as LR v2: 2,500 and the same 6 rooms (0,1,2,5,6,7) by ~25M frames, flat to 400M (run a found one more reward at ~390M: best 2,600). Frozen test, 192 games per run: mean 2,281 / 2,228, median 2,500, 89% of games score 2,500, the rest 500 (died on the route). Stuck at room 7's laser gates: ~33k lives lost per run right at its entrance (x 0-20); median room-7 x reached 11, past x=100 in 0.1% of games. The learned explorers stay at 99.4% of uniform entropy (shipped entropy_coef 1.0, tuned for the seeded research run). This is a fresh start: the research run began from run14's trained novelty models and an 800-game seed pool, which are not in the package.

paper.label: GoWU Phase I (paper, Fig. 6 / Table 2)
paper.note: 50M/100M/200M are midpoints of ranges read off Fig. 6 (20-30k, 45-60k, 75-85k); 400M is Table 2's mean over 100 seeds.

iterations.label: LR v1 · room landmarks
iterations.change: First implementation. Plan default: one landmark per (level, room).
iterations.verdict: π_R learns to fetch the key, but one landmark per room gives no foothold past it. Stuck at 100.

iterations.label: LR v1 · cell landmarks
iterations.verdict: Reachability-gate bug excluded every key landmark after 32 early failures; everything explored from the start. Stuck at 100.

iterations.label: LR v2 · gate fix
iterations.change: Gate spares landmarks with demos; ineligible goals fall back to the nearest eligible ancestor; doomed gate needs 16 handoffs. Ran 122M frames, then was resumed from that checkpoint (commit 4856311: network, RND, landmark archive; demos and Adam moments rebuilt, 50-update lr warm-up) to ~250M.
iterations.verdict: 6 rooms, 2,500 by ~35M frames and a robust policy, then flat to ~250M frames (still 2,500, same 6 rooms, landmarks +9 / +1 after the resume). 90% of frames go to return trips and random bursts can't clear the next room. Returns kept improving (success 82-96%, BC acc ~0.93) while entropy fell 0.65 -> 0.23; final eval mean 2,425 / 2,500. The bottleneck is exploration past the handoff, not the return policy.

iterations.label: LR v2 · infinite lives
iterations.change: Baseline B2′ (PLAN §7): v2 with infinite lives (ram_refill). A life loss no longer ends the episode: during return it counts as a failure, and exploration continues from the respawn point. Warm-started from v2's ~122M checkpoint, same as v2's resumed segment. Caveat: MR respawns at the room entrance, which is a free local reset, so this is not comparable to GoWU.
